selected.title: Make benchmark translation-angle errors invariant to reconstruction scale
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Make benchmark translation-angle errors invariant to reconstruction scale.
selected.summary_zh: 修复基准评估中的向量归一化，使平移方向角误差不受重建尺度影响。
selected.technical_value: Scales finite nonzero vectors by their maximum absolute component before normalization, avoiding tiny-norm floors and overflow while preserving zero-vector behavior.
selected.limitations: Changes benchmark pose-error evaluation, not the reconstruction solver or reconstructed-model quality. Final merged tests are geometry_test.py and utils_test.py; the PR body's original test-command path differs from the final files. This refresh did not rerun tests.

selected.title: fix: preserve padded sequence lengths in LSTM outputs
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Preserve padded LSTM sequence lengths so token outputs stay aligned with companion features.
selected.summary_zh: 保留 LSTM 输出的原始填充长度，使 token 输出与其他特征维度对齐。
selected.technical_value: Passes the original padded width as total_length when unpacking packed recurrent sequences, preventing batch-dependent shortening of token_embeddings.
selected.limitations: The final merged diff contains only the production LSTM module; preparation-time regression results should not be described as tests added in the merged patch. No GPU DataParallel or model-quality improvement is claimed.

selected.title: Preserve representation batch result structure
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Preserve consistent result structure for empty, singleton and multi-image representation batches.
selected.summary_zh: 保持空批次、单图批次与多图批次的人脸表征结果结构一致。
selected.technical_value: Determines batch shape from input form rather than length; keeps scalar-image output flat, retains the outer batch dimension for list/4D inputs and returns empty batches before loading a model.
selected.limitations: Corrects the representation API's batch structure; the singleton-batch output shape intentionally changes. The merged regression uses SFace inference; no recognition-accuracy improvement is claimed.

selected.title: fix(vla_jepa): pair rotary frequencies with adjacent coordinates
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Apply the established pairwise RoPE correction to VLA-JEPA's training-only world predictor.
selected.summary_zh: 将已有的成对 RoPE 修正应用到 VLA-JEPA 训练期世界预测器，恢复相邻坐标的频率配对。
selected.technical_value: Rotary position geometry; norm, inner-product and relative-position invariants; single-frequency broadcasting.
selected.limitations: Correction originated in echosprint's V-JEPA 2 PR #15; not an original algorithm. The final merged diff contains the production helper and documentation, without new regression tests. This affects the training-only predictor: checkpoint outputs and losses change; no pretrained-quality or real-robot performance claim. This selection review did not rerun tests.

selected.title: fix(artifacts): complete positional ZIP reads
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Complete short positional ZIP reads and report premature EOF as an integrity failure.
selected.summary_zh: 补全 ZIP 定位读取中的短读，并将提前 EOF 明确报告为完整性错误。
selected.technical_value: Low-level I/O correctness: accumulate partial reads with consistent buffer and file offsets, detect premature EOF, and preserve existing allocation and read-budget checks. Regressions exercise real ZIP parsing and extraction through actual file descriptors.
selected.limitations: Archive-reader correctness, with no throughput or expanded security-boundary claim. Short reads are injected on real descriptors. Full-suite, cross-platform and forced-short-read public CLI/MCP coverage are not established by the PR; this selection review did not rerun tests.

selection_policy: Current upstream stars >10000, merged and Afloat16 authored, substantive correctness fixes supported by inspected production diffs; selected recent contributions ordered by merged_at descending. Not claimed to be the newest contiguous five merged PRs.

excluded_recent.reason: 8,893 stars is below the strict >10,000 threshold.
Valid contribution, but a basic nonpositive parameter check is less representative than checkpoint state ownership; retained in full record.
Valid contribution, but straightforward client-list deduplication is less representative; retained in full record.
Useful benchmark path resolution, but the final production diff is a basic two-path resolve operation; the numerical geometry fix better represents technical depth.
Useful thin-image boundary fix; lower priority than the newer batch-contract and numerical-gradient fixes for this five-item technical selection.
Corrects width/height metadata assignment; lower priority than the broader batch-contract fix.
Substantive NT-Xent value/gradient stability contribution, but the current 6,343 stars is below the strict >10,000 threshold.
